equation_summary: Product-key addressing: split per-head score vector into two halves q1,q2 of width sqrt(slots); take per-half top-k_sub via torch.topk; form pairwise-additive combined scores top_val1[a]+top_val2[b] (fused_outer_add_topk), take overall top-k, address = idx1*half_key+idx2, then sort addresses ascending (stable bitonic argsort or torch.sort). Route weights are ScaledSoftmax (softmax with scale, default 1.0) over the selected scores, separately for write (write_act) and read (read_act). State update per selected slot (token order, unique within token): retrieved = sum_n w_n * M[idx_n]*exp(g); delta = beta*(v - retrieved); M[idx_n] = M[idx_n]*exp(g) + w_n*delta; read AFTER update: y = sum_n q_val_n * M[q_idx_n].
state_shape: per-partition [slots_per_partition, Dv] slot-value bank; P=B*H partitions
gate_scope: data-dependent scalar-per-head log-decay g=-A*softplus(a_proj(x)+dt_bias) and beta=sigmoid(b_proj(x)); optional key_weighted_decay makes decay per-write-slot (exp(g*k_val))
normalization: softmax route weights (read_act/write_act, ScaledSoftmax with configurable scale); no state denominator

CONFIRM the update law matches U3.D decayed-delta: selected-slot decay exp(g), retrieved weighted sum, delta=beta*(v-retrieved), write w_n*delta, after-update read (layer.py:740-759 and adapter mutation_order 'decay_retrieve_delta_scatter_then_read', upstream.py:440).

The URM adapter pins scale=1.0 and Softmax, so the adapter-frozen configuration matches R.PK up to the tie-policy gap.
